Nadia: quick proposal: running a conditional-speculative experiment for tess-14b-quant to limit the coherence regressions we've been seeing on long multi-step prompts.
Eddie: curious — what's the conditioning signal?
Nadia: two cheap signals computed at routing: named_entity_density (entities / 100 tokens) and numeric_token_fraction. If named_entity_density > 0.12 OR numeric_token_fraction > 0.03 -> use conservative sampler (accept=0.78, prefetch=8). Else use aggressive sampler (accept=0.6, prefetch=32). Baseline remains greedy.
Rohit: sounds reasonable. Any toy config to share?
Nadia: paste: ```{ "policy": "conditional_spec", "signals": ["named_entity_density","numeric_token_fraction"], "thresholds": {"ned":0.12,"num_frac":0.03}, "conservative": {"accept":0.78,"prefetch":8}, "aggressive": {"accept":0.6,"prefetch":32} }```
Lena: how will we evaluate? metric set?
Nadia: stratified 12k prompts: 40% multi-hop instruct, 30% factual trivia, 20% longform, 10% short chat. Track: exact-match (EM) for trivia, micro-ROUGE-L for longform, deterministic rerank MRR, p50/p95 token latency, per-prompt kv_warmup_hits, accept_rate, top1_prob_drop, and token_entropy. Also export top-500 disagreement diffs for human review.
Eddie: any quant artifact plans? GPTQ4 and int8?
Nadia: run arm A: GPTQ4 baseline, arm B: GPTQ4 + conditional_spec, arm C: int8 baseline, arm D: int8 + conditional_spec.
Rohit: rollout guardrails?
Nadia: autopilot: abort if cohort EM drop > 1.0 (long_stratum) or p95 latency > 2x. Also disable sampler for any prompt with named_entity_density>0.25 (super-high entities) regardless of policy.
Lena: example diff to watch for?
Nadia: excerpt: PROMPT: "Outline steps to reconcile Q3 revenue and audit trail for ACME": BASELINE: stepwise checklist referencing ledger export + reconciliation queries. AGGRESSIVE-SAMPLER: summary loses the explicit ledger-export command. NOTE: that's exactly the failure mode we want to catch via entity-density gating.
Eddie: good. any quick pre-run sanity numbers?
Nadia: small 1k pilot: overall p50 token latency -28% on aggressive sampler, conservative sampler p50 -12%. Aggressive had ROUGE-L delta -1.3 on longform; conservative -0.4. Named-entity gating would route ~22% of traffic to conservative.
Rohit: please include bootstrap CI on short/long strata and per-prompt features in output so we can model conditional cost vs quality.
Nadia: yes. scheduling a full run on staging tomorrow (job label: conditional-spec-tess-2026-03-22). ops-bot: queued job conditional-spec-tess-2026-03-22 -> staging (job id: 9892)
Lena: once results are in, let's feed per-config stats to Redwood Optimize and request recommended quant+batch knobs for the conservative lane.
Eddie: also put top disagreement diffs in /mnt/holdouts/conditional_spec_tess_2026 for human reviewers.
Nadia: will do. everyone ok with proceeding?
Rohit: go for it.
Lena: thumbs up.
